summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about exploratory discussions with Florida Atlantic University and the University of Michigan regarding AI-powered wave energy and WaveGPT development. No definitive agreement, financial terms, or binding commitment is disclosed. The filing reports a routine business development and strategic meeting, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are mentioned. This is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, furnishing material non-financial information; therefore, it does not qualify as an acquisition, divestiture, or any other special-situation event.
